name: skills
title_zh: 从零搭到上云的 .NET 企业级工程手册
tagline_zh: 不是零散代码片段，是能照着走的完整工程路径：从 ASP.NET Core 分层、微服务拆分。
tagline_en: Not snippets — a walkable path from ASP.NET Core layering to microservices and Azure OpenAI multi-agent.
desc_en: Complete engineering playbook and agent skills for building enterprise ASP.NET Core solutions, distributed microservices, and autonomous Azure OpenAI / MAF multi-agent systems via npx skills add
why_zh: 把分散在多年实战里的架构决策、代码规范和部署坑，压成一条按序执行的 skill 链。
why_en: Compresses years of architecture calls, code standards, and deployment gotchas into an ordered skill chain — follow it to get an.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 .NET / Azure 技术栈，不含 Java、Go 或前端；skill 产出的是工程骨架与配置模板。
limit_en: .NET/Azure only; no Java, Go, or frontend. Outputs are skeletons & config templates, not business logic. Requires .NET SDK 8+, Azure CLI, and access.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
